# EverythingApp - Full Implementation Spec

> Engineering document. Every file, function, endpoint, and schema is specified so a code agent can implement each task without architectural decisions.

---

## 0. Architecture Overview

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  FRONTEND - React + Vite + TypeScript                   │
│  web/  (new directory, separate from cli/)               │
│  ├─ assistant-ui primitives (Thread, Composer, etc.)    │
│  ├─ Tailwind CSS (black/white minimalist theme)         │
│  ├─ Custom components: Sidebar, Gazeta, Settings,       │
│  │  ApprovalModal, FileViewer, ConnectorDashboard       │
│  └─ SSE streaming (no polling)                          │
└──────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────┘
                       │ /api/* (same-origin, proxied in dev)
┌──────────────────────▼──────────────────────────────────┐
│  BACKEND - Express (existing cli/src/server.ts, expanded)│
│  ├─ SQLite (better-sqlite3) - conversations, messages,  │
│  │  settings, gazeta_items, batch_jobs                   │
│  ├─ SSE endpoint for streaming turn progress            │
│  ├─ MCP Client Manager (existing, expanded)             │
│  ├─ WebApprovalGate (existing, expanded)                │
│  ├─ Batch Manager (existing, expanded)                  │
│  ├─ Gazeta Engine (new)                                 │
│  ├─ Output Truncator (new)                              │
│  └─ Kill Switch (new, AbortController per turn)         │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  MCP CONNECTORS (external processes, not in this repo)  │
│  ├─ sandbox-mcp (bash/git, existing)                    │
│  ├─ obsidian-livesync-mcp (vault, existing)             │
│  ├─ github-mcp-server (official, OAuth)                 │
│  └─ n8n MCP Server Trigger (pipeline control)           │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

**Key decisions:**
- Frontend is a **separate `web/` directory** with its own `package.json`, Vite dev server proxies `/api` to Express on :3000. Production build outputs static files served by Express.
- **SQLite via `better-sqlite3`** - zero extra services, single file at `~/.everythingapp/everythingapp.db`. Replaces `history.json`.
- **SSE (Server-Sent Events)** replaces 1.5s polling for turn progress and approvals.
- **`assistant-ui`** provides composable chat primitives (streaming, markdown, tool calls, auto-scroll, branching). We style it with our own black/white theme via Tailwind.
- **All UI text in English.**

---

## 1. Database Schema (SQLite)

File: `cli/src/db.ts`

```sql
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS conversations (
  id            TEXT PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT (lower(hex(randomblob(8)))),
  title         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'New conversation',
  system_prompt TEXT,               -- per-conversation override, NULL = use global
  model         TEXT,               -- per-conversation override, NULL = use global
  sandbox_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  created_at    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  updated_at    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS messages (
  id              INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES conversations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  role            TEXT NOT NULL,     -- 'user' | 'assistant'
  content         TEXT NOT NULL,     -- JSON string (Anthropic MessageParam.content)
  created_at      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);
CREATE INDEX idx_messages_conv ON messages(conversation_id, id);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS settings (
  key   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  value TEXT NOT NULL
);
-- Seeded with defaults:
-- 'global_system_prompt' -> default system prompt
-- 'default_model'        -> 'claude-sonnet-5'
-- 'custom_instructions'  -> ''

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gazeta_items (
  id              TEXT PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT (lower(hex(randomblob(8)))),
  type            TEXT NOT NULL,     -- 'approval' | 'batch_result' | 'agent_question' | 'daily_summary'
  conversation_id TEXT REFERENCES conversations(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  title           TEXT NOT NULL,
  description     TEXT,              -- markdown body / TLDR
  input_schema    TEXT,              -- JSON: form fields the user needs to fill
  response        TEXT,              -- JSON: user's answer (NULL until responded)
  status          TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', -- 'pending' | 'responded' | 'dismissed'
  created_at      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  responded_at    TEXT
);
CREATE INDEX idx_gazeta_status ON gazeta_items(status);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS batch_jobs (
  id              TEXT PRIMARY KEY,  -- Anthropic batch ID
  conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES conversations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  custom_id       TEXT NOT NULL,
  user_text       TEXT NOT NULL,     -- the message that was batched
  preview         TEXT NOT NULL,     -- first 80 chars
  status          TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', -- 'pending' | 'succeeded' | 'errored' | 'expired'
  result_text     TEXT,              -- assistant's reply when succeeded
  submitted_at    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  resolved_at     TEXT
);
CREATE INDEX idx_batch_conv ON batch_jobs(conversation_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_batch_status ON batch_jobs(status);
```

## 2. Backend API (Express)

File: `cli/src/server.ts` (rewrite)

All endpoints under `/api` require `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (existing logic).

### 2.1 Conversations

| Method | Path | Request Body | Response | Notes |
|--------|------|-------------|----------|-------|
| `GET` | `/api/conversations` | - | `{ conversations: [{ id, title, updatedAt, messageCount }] }` | Sorted by updatedAt DESC |
| `POST` | `/api/conversations` | `{ title?, systemPrompt?, model?, sandboxEnabled? }` | `{ id }` | Creates new conversation |
| `GET` | `/api/conversations/:id` | - | `{ id, title, systemPrompt, model, sandboxEnabled, createdAt, updatedAt }` | 404 if not found |
| `PATCH` | `/api/conversations/:id` | `{ title?, systemPrompt?, model?, sandboxEnabled? }` | `{ ok: true }` | Partial update |
| `DELETE` | `/api/conversations/:id` | - | `{ ok: true }` | Cascade deletes messages |

### 2.2 Messages & Turns

| Method | Path | Request Body | Response | Notes |
|--------|------|-------------|----------|-------|
| `GET` | `/api/conversations/:id/messages` | - | `{ messages: MessageParam[] }` | Full history for conversation |
| `POST` | `/api/conversations/:id/message` | `{ text: string, batch?: boolean }` | `{ turnId: number }` or `{ batchId: string }` | If `batch=true`, submits via Batch API instead. 409 if turn already running in this conversation |
| `POST` | `/api/conversations/:id/kill` | - | `{ ok: true }` | Aborts running turn via AbortController |
| `DELETE` | `/api/conversations/:id/messages` | - | `{ ok: true }` | Clears conversation history |

### 2.3 Streaming (SSE)

| Method | Path | Notes |
|--------|------|-------|
| `GET` | `/api/conversations/:id/stream` | SSE endpoint. Events: `turn:start`, `turn:text` (streaming text chunks), `turn:tool_use` (tool call started), `turn:tool_result` (tool call finished), `turn:done`, `turn:error`, `approval:pending`, `approval:resolved` |

Client connects on page load, reconnects on drop. Replaces all polling.

### 2.4 Approvals

| Method | Path | Request Body | Response |
|--------|------|-------------|----------|
| `GET` | `/api/pending-approvals` | - | `{ pending: PendingApproval[] }` |
| `POST` | `/api/approve` | `{ id, approved, alwaysAllow? }` | `{ ok: true }` |

### 2.5 Settings

| Method | Path | Request Body | Response |
|--------|------|-------------|----------|
| `GET` | `/api/settings` | - | `{ settings: Record<string, string> }` |
| `PUT` | `/api/settings` | `{ key: string, value: string }` | `{ ok: true }` |

### 2.6 Connectors (MCP status)

| Method | Path | Response |
|--------|------|----------|
| `GET` | `/api/connectors` | `{ connectors: [{ name, url, connected, toolCount, tools: [{ name, description }] }] }` |

### 2.7 Gazeta

| Method | Path | Request Body | Response |
|--------|------|-------------|----------|
| `GET` | `/api/gazeta` | query: `?status=pending` | `{ items: GazetaItem[] }` |
| `POST` | `/api/gazeta/:id/respond` | `{ response: any }` | `{ ok: true }` |
| `POST` | `/api/gazeta/:id/dismiss` | - | `{ ok: true }` |

### 2.8 Batch Jobs

| Method | Path | Response |
|--------|------|----------|
| `GET` | `/api/batches` | `{ jobs: BatchJob[] }` |
| `GET` | `/api/conversations/:id/batches` | `{ jobs: BatchJob[] }` | Only for that conversation |

### 2.9 Usage

| Method | Path | Response |
|--------|------|----------|
| `GET` | `/api/usage` | `{ session: { inputTokens, outputTokens, cacheWrite, cacheRead, costUsd }, perConversation: { [convId]: { costUsd } } }` |

### 2.10 Health

| Method | Path | Response | Auth |
|--------|------|----------|------|
| `GET` | `/health` | `{ status: 'ok', connectors: { name: connected }[] }` | **No auth** |

## 3. Backend - New Modules

### 3.1 `cli/src/output-truncator.ts`

```typescript
const DEFAULT_MAX_LENGTH = 30_000; // characters

/**
 * Truncates tool output for the model context. Keeps first and last portions,
 * inserts a marker in the middle. The full output is stored separately for
 * the UI to display on demand.
 */
export function truncateToolOutput(
  text: string,
  maxLength: number = DEFAULT_MAX_LENGTH
): { truncated: string; wasTruncated: boolean; originalLength: number } {
  if (text.length <= maxLength) return { truncated: text, wasTruncated: false, originalLength: text.length };
  const keepEach = Math.floor((maxLength - 100) / 2);
  const head = text.slice(0, keepEach);
  const tail = text.slice(-keepEach);
  const removed = text.length - keepEach * 2;
  return {
    truncated: `${head}\n\n[...truncated ${removed} characters from middle...]\n\n${tail}`,
    wasTruncated: true,
    originalLength: text.length,
  };
}
```

### 3.2 Kill Switch - changes to `cli/src/anthropic-loop.ts`

Add `signal?: AbortSignal` to `ConversationDeps`. Check before each API call and each tool execution:

```typescript
if (deps.signal?.aborted) {
  throw new Error('Turn aborted by user (kill switch)');
}
```

Server creates an `AbortController` per turn, stores it keyed by `conversationId`. `POST /api/conversations/:id/kill` calls `controller.abort()`.

### 3.3 SSE Manager - `cli/src/sse.ts`

```typescript
import type { Response } from 'express';

export class SSEManager {
  private clients = new Map<string, Set<Response>>(); // conversationId -> connected clients

  addClient(conversationId: string, res: Response): void;
  removeClient(conversationId: string, res: Response): void;
  emit(conversationId: string, event: string, data: unknown): void;
  emitAll(event: string, data: unknown): void; // broadcast (for gazeta updates)
}
```

### 3.4 Gazeta Engine - `cli/src/gazeta.ts`

```typescript
/**
 * The Gazeta ("daily paper") aggregates all items that need human attention
 * across all conversations: pending approvals that timed out, batch results
 * that need review, agent questions that weren't answered in-chat.
 *
 * Items are created by:
 * 1. Batch job resolution -> auto-creates gazeta_item with type='batch_result'
 * 2. Agent explicitly requesting input -> model calls a special tool 'request_human_input'
 *    with a title, description, and optional form schema
 * 3. Background daily summary -> batch API generates a digest of all conversations
 */
export function createBatchResultItem(db: Database, job: BatchJob): string;
export function createAgentQuestionItem(db: Database, convId: string, title: string, description: string, schema?: unknown): string;
export function generateDailySummary(db: Database, anthropic: AnthropicLike, model: string): Promise<string>; // returns gazeta item id
```

The `request_human_input` tool is a **virtual tool** - not from any MCP server. It's injected into the tool list by the server and handled internally:

```typescript
const VIRTUAL_TOOLS: Anthropic.Tool[] = [
  {
    name: 'request_human_input',
    description: 'Request input from the user that can be answered later (via Gazeta). Use when the question is not urgent and can wait for the user\'s next review session.',
    input_schema: {
      type: 'object',
      properties: {
        title: { type: 'string', description: 'Short title for the request' },
        description: { type: 'string', description: 'Detailed description with context, markdown supported' },
        choices: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' }, description: 'Optional predefined choices' },
      },
      required: ['title', 'description'],
    },
  },
];
```

### 4.2 Design System - Black/White Minimalist

Tailwind config:

```typescript
// tailwind.config.ts
export default {
  theme: {
    extend: {
      colors: {
        bg: { DEFAULT: '#000000', secondary: '#0a0a0a', tertiary: '#141414' },
        fg: { DEFAULT: '#ffffff', secondary: '#a0a0a0', tertiary: '#666666' },
        accent: '#ffffff',
        border: { DEFAULT: '#1a1a1a', hover: '#2a2a2a' },
        danger: '#ff4444',
        success: '#44ff44',
      },
      borderRadius: {
        container: '16px',
        button: '12px',

      },

        sans: ['Inter', 'system-ui', 'sans-serif'],

      },

```

**Design rules:**
- Background: pure black `#000`
- Containers: white with rounded corners (`rounded-container`), black text inside
- OR: dark containers (`bg-tertiary`) with white text - alternate style for cards
- User messages: white bubble, black text, right-aligned
- Assistant messages: no bubble (flat), white text on black, left-aligned
- Tool calls: collapsible card with `bg-tertiary` background, monospace args
- Approval modals: white border, red border for dangerous
- Typography: Inter for body, JetBrains Mono for code
- Zero color - everything is grayscale. Only exception: red for danger/errors, subtle green for success badges

### 4.3 Key Component Behavior

#### `Sidebar.tsx`
- List of conversations sorted by `updatedAt` DESC
- Each item: title (truncated), relative time ("2h ago")
- "+" button at top creates new conversation
- Active conversation highlighted with white left border
- Bottom: Gazeta button with pending count badge, Settings gear icon
- Mobile: hidden by default, slides in from left on hamburger tap

#### `ChatView.tsx`
- Wraps `assistant-ui` `<Thread>` component with custom message renderers
- Connects to SSE endpoint for real-time streaming
- Shows typing indicator during turn
- Auto-scrolls, with "↓ New messages" button when scrolled up
- Empty state: "Start a conversation" with suggestions

#### `ToolCallCard.tsx`
- Collapsed by default: shows tool name + status icon (✓/✗/⏳)
- Expanded: shows arguments (JSON, syntax highlighted), result (markdown), execution time
- If output was truncated: "Show full output" button -> FileViewer modal
- Dangerous calls: red left border

#### `ApprovalModal.tsx`
- Triggered via SSE `approval:pending` event
- Full-width modal overlay
- Shows: connector/tool name, arguments (formatted JSON), dangerous warning if applicable
- Three buttons: "Deny" (gray), "Approve" (white), "Always allow" (only if not dangerous)
- Keyboard: Enter = approve, Escape = deny

#### `Composer.tsx`
- Textarea with auto-resize (max 200px)
- Send button (white arrow on black)
- Batch toggle: small "⏱ Batch" chip - when active, sends with `batch: true`
- File attach button (paperclip icon)
- Enter sends, Shift+Enter new line

#### `StopButton.tsx`
- Red square icon, only visible when turn is running
- Calls `POST /api/conversations/:id/kill`
- Shows spinner briefly then disappears

#### `GazetaView.tsx`
- Full page (replaces chat when navigated to from sidebar)
- Header: "Inbox" + pending count + "Dismiss all read" button
- Cards sorted by created_at DESC
- Each card (`GazetaCard`): type badge, title, description (markdown), response form
- Response forms: text input, choice buttons, or custom schema-driven form
- "Open source conversation" link -> navigates to the originating chat
- After responding, card fades to "responded" state (gray, collapsed)

#### `SettingsModal.tsx`
- Accessible from sidebar gear icon
- Tabs: General, Connectors, About
- **General**: Custom instructions (textarea), Default model (dropdown), Theme (future)
- **Connectors**: List of MCP connectors with status (green/red dot), tool count, expand to see tool list. Each tool has "Auto-approve" toggle.
- **About**: Version, usage stats, links

## 5. Implementation Tasks (ordered, for Sonnet)

> Each task is a self-contained unit of work. Complete them in order. Run `npm run build` after each backend task to verify TypeScript compiles. Run the app after each frontend task to visually verify.

### Phase A: Backend Foundation

**A1.** Install `better-sqlite3` and `@types/better-sqlite3` in `cli/`. Create `cli/src/db.ts` with the exact schema from Section 1. Export all functions listed. Write unit tests in `cli/src/__tests__/db.test.ts` covering create/list/get/update/delete for conversations and messages.

**A2.** Create `cli/src/output-truncator.ts` with the exact implementation from Section 3.1. Write unit tests: input under limit -> unchanged, input over limit -> truncated with marker, edge cases (empty string, exactly at limit).

**A3.** Create `cli/src/sse.ts` with the `SSEManager` class from Section 3.3. Clients stored per conversation ID. `addClient` sets SSE headers (`Content-Type: text/event-stream`, `Cache-Control: no-cache`, `Connection: keep-alive`), sends initial `:keepalive` comment. `emit` writes `event: <name>\ndata: <JSON>\n\n`. Handles client disconnect cleanup.

**A4.** Modify `cli/src/anthropic-loop.ts`: add `signal?: AbortSignal` and `maxToolOutputLength?: number` to `ConversationDeps`. Check `signal.aborted` before each `anthropic.messages.create()` call and before each `tools.call()`. Apply `truncateToolOutput()` to tool results before adding to messages array. Pass full (untruncated) output via new `onToolResult?: (toolName: string, fullOutput: string, truncatedOutput: string) => void` callback.

**A5.** Create `cli/src/gazeta.ts` with functions from Section 3.4. Implement the `request_human_input` virtual tool definition. The tool handler creates a gazeta item in SQLite and returns "Your question has been queued for the user's next review session." to the model.

**A6.** Rewrite `cli/src/server.ts`:
- Import and initialize `openDb()` + `runMigrations()` at startup
- Replace global `history` array with per-conversation SQLite operations
- Replace `turnState` with a `Map<string, TurnState>` keyed by conversation ID
- Store `AbortController` per conversation for kill switch
- Implement ALL endpoints from Section 2 (conversations, messages, stream, approvals, settings, connectors, gazeta, batches, usage, health)
- SSE endpoint: create `SSEManager`, wire it into `runTurn` callbacks (`onAssistantText` -> `turn:text` event, `onToolStart` -> `turn:tool_use`, approval gate -> `approval:pending`)
- Inject `request_human_input` virtual tool alongside MCP tools
- Serve `web/dist/` as static files (production), fallback `index.html` for SPA routing
- Keep existing hardening: helmet, timing-safe auth, graceful shutdown, error handler, uncaught exception logging

**A7.** Migrate `cli/src/batch-store.ts` to use SQLite (`batch_jobs` table) instead of JSON file. Update `resolvePendingBatches()` in server to create gazeta items when batch completes.

**A8.** Run `npm run build`, fix any TypeScript errors. Run `npm test`, ensure all existing tests pass + new db/truncator tests pass.

### Phase B: Frontend

**B1.** Create `web/` directory. Initialize with Vite + React + TypeScript. Install: `@assistant-ui/react`, `tailwindcss`, `@tailwindcss/typography`, `react-markdown`, `remark-gfm`, `rehype-highlight`, `lucide-react` (icons). Configure Tailwind with the theme from Section 4.2. Configure Vite proxy: `/api` -> `http://localhost:3000`. Create `web/public/manifest.json` (PWA manifest, black theme).

**B2.** Create `web/src/api.ts`: fetch wrapper that reads token from `localStorage`, adds `Authorization` header, handles 401 -> redirect to login. Create `web/src/hooks/useSSE.ts`: connects to `/api/conversations/:id/stream`, parses events, returns reactive state.

**B3.** Create `web/src/components/layout/Layout.tsx`, `Sidebar.tsx`, `Header.tsx`. Implement the sidebar with conversation list (uses `GET /api/conversations`), new conversation button, gazeta link with counter, settings gear. Responsive: sidebar toggleable on mobile. Pure black background, white text.

**B4.** Create `web/src/lib/runtime.ts`: adapter connecting `assistant-ui`'s `ExternalStoreRuntime` to our API. Maps our SSE events to assistant-ui's message format. Handles sending messages via `POST /api/conversations/:id/message`.
